CoupleCAM offline comic editor

Animation portrait: Face Portrait v2, additional portrait weights by Bryan Lee
https://github.com/bryandlee/animegan2-pytorch
ONNX conversion by Kazuhito Takahashi, face_paint_512_v2_0.onnx
https://github.com/Kazuhito00/AnimeGANv2-ONNX-Sample
Renamed to face-portrait.onnx. Weights unmodified.
See portrait-LICENSE.txt and conversion-LICENSE.txt.

Storybook: DCT-Net by Alibaba, Inc. and its affiliates.
Storybook preset: iic/cv_unet_person-image-cartoon-sd-design_compound-models
https://www.modelscope.cn/models/iic/cv_unet_person-image-cartoon-sd-design_compound-models
Published cartoon_h.pb SHA256 a9f0ebcdce3152429b1169d3c5501ffd8b3ab7614622a5f420620056fb50f1cf
The storybook model card specifies Apache License 2.0. See dct-LICENSE.txt.
CoupleCAM converted the frozen TensorFlow graph to portable ONNX opset 16,
with normalized NCHW BGR input and output. Weights were not retrained.
Inference uses the authors' single-pass full-image approach.

Comic ink: Informative Drawings, Caroline Chan et al.
https://github.com/carolineec/informative-drawings
The grayscale frame emitted by manga-lines.onnx is displayed as line art.
See drawing-LICENSE.txt.

Microsoft ONNX Runtime Web 1.18.0, WebAssembly single-thread runtime.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.18.0
See runtime-LICENSE.txt and runtime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.

Preset thumbnails were produced from CoupleCAM's bundled sample using these
same drawing pipelines. All user photos are processed on the device.
